title: The Last Sovereign's Tear
summary: At the family memorial in Seoul, Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun place their parents' photograph at rest, offering a final tear of gratitude before stepping into their eternal tomorrow.

panels.shot: the quiet hillside memorial cemetery overlooking seoul at twilight
panels.action: A serene, pine-covered hillside cemetery overlooking the glittering skyline of Seoul under an indigo twilight sky.
panels.prose_en: A serene, pine-covered hillside cemetery overlooking the glittering skyline of Seoul under an indigo twilight sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ek shant, devdar se dhaka pahadi kabristan, neel dhundhale aakash ke neeche seoul ke chamakdar kshitij ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: two clean granite memorial markers bearing the names of their parents
panels.action: Two polished black granite stones read: 'Kang Min-Soo — Father & Guardian' and 'Park Eun-Ji — Mother of Sovereigns'.
panels.prose_en: Two polished black granite stones read: 'Kang Min-Soo — Father & Guardian' and 'Park Eun-Ji — Mother of Sovereigns'.
panels.prose_hi: Do polish kiye gaye kale granite pattharon par likha tha: 'cong min-su - pita aur abhibhavak' aur 'park un-ji - samprabhuon ki mata'.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun standing quietly before the graves in black suits
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand side by side in neat black formal suits, holding fresh white chrysanthemums.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand side by side in neat black formal suits, holding fresh white chrysanthemums.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur taaye-jun saf-suthre kale aupcharik suit mein taja safed guldaudi pakde hue ek saath khade han.

panels.shot: kuro sitting quietly on the headstone his head bowed with dignity
panels.action: Kuro sits perched on the stone marker, his head bowed respectfully, black feathers still in the evening breeze.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Min-Soo... Eun-Ji... Your sons have surpassed every god in creation.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sits perched on the stone marker, his head bowed respectfully, black feathers still in the evening breeze.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro patthar ke nishan par baitha hai, uska sir sammanpurvak jhuka hua hai, sham ki hawa mein abhi bhi kale pankh han.

panels.shot: tae-jun kneeling down laying his bouquet of white flowers on father's grave
panels.action: Tae-Jun kneels gently, placing his white flowers before their father's stone: 'Dad... I brought Ha-Jun home safe.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dad... Maine apna vaada poora kiya. Ha-Jun is safe.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun kneels gently, placing his white flowers before their father's stone: 'Dad... I brought Ha-Jun home safe.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apne safed phool apne pita ki shila ke samne rakhte hue dheere se ghutne tekate han: 'pitaji... main ha-jun ko surakshit ghar le aaya.'

panels.shot: ha-jun kneeling beside tae-jun laying his flowers on mother's grave
panels.action: Ha-Jun places his bouquet before their mother's stone: 'Mom... I remember your cooking. I remember your smile.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mummy... Mujhe aapki hansi yaad aa gayi. Thank you for giving me life.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun places his bouquet before their mother's stone: 'Mom... I remember your cooking. I remember your smile.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna guldasta apni maa ke patthar ke samne rakhta hai: 'maa... mujhe aapka khana banana yaad hai. mujhe tumhari muskan yaad hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling the old childhood photograph from his inner pocket
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes out the restored Namsan Tower photograph from Chapter 64, uncreased and clean.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes out the restored Namsan Tower photograph from Chapter 64, uncreased and clean.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne adhyay 64 se punarsthapit namson tower ki tasveer nikali, jo bina bani aur saaf thi.

panels.shot: ha-jun placing the photograph inside a crystal waterproof memorial frame
panels.action: Ha-Jun sets the photo into a crystal frame between both gravestones, sealing it with a touch of warm starlight mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sets the photo into a crystal frame between both gravestones, sealing it with a touch of warm starlight mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne photo ko donon kabron ke beech ek crystal frame mein set kiya hai, ise garm starlite maina ke sparsh se seal kar diya hai.

panels.shot: a gentle, warm autumn breeze sweeping across the hillside
panels.action: A warm, comforting breeze rustles the pine needles, carrying the scent of wild jasmine and mountain rain.

dialogue.text: It felt like a mother's gentle hand stroking their hair.

panels.prose_en: A warm, comforting breeze rustles the pine needles, carrying the scent of wild jasmine and mountain rain.
panels.prose_hi: Ek garm, aaramdayak hawa cheed ki suiyon ko sarsrahat deti hai, jisme junglee chameli aur pahadi baarish ki khushboo aati hai.

panels.shot: a single crimson-violet tear falling from ha-jun eye onto the stone
panels.action: A single crystal tear slips from Ha-Jun's royal violet eye, falling onto the polished granite marker.

dialogue.text: The Last Sovereign's Tear. Not of grief, but of eternal gratitude.

panels.prose_en: A single crystal tear slips from Ha-Jun's royal violet eye, falling onto the polished granite marker.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki shahi baingani aankh se ek crystal aansu fisalkar polish granite marker par gir raha hai.

panels.shot: the tear touching the stone igniting a soft, permanent golden ward of peace
panels.action: Where the tear strikes, a soft ring of golden starlight permanently blooms, blessing the grave with eternal flowers.
panels.prose_en: Where the tear strikes, a soft ring of golden starlight permanently blooms, blessing the grave with eternal flowers.
panels.prose_hi: Jahan aansu takrate han, vahan sunhare taron ki roshni ka ek naram ghera sthayi roop se khilta hai, jo kabr ko shashwat phoolon se ashirwad deta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun wrapping his arm around ha-jun shoulders smiling warmly
panels.action: Tae-Jun wraps his arm around Ha-Jun, pulling him close: 'Let's head back. Min-Jae booked a table at the BBQ place.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Chalo, Ha-Jun. Min-Jae ne samgyeopsal order kiya hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun wraps his arm around Ha-Jun, pulling him close: 'Let's head back. Min-Jae booked a table at the BBQ place.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne ha-jun ke charon or apna haath lapeta, use kareeb khinchte hue kaha: 'chalo peeche chalte han. min-je ne bbq sthan par ek table book ki.'

panels.shot: ha-jun wiping his eye smiling broadly: 'samgyeopsal? who is paying?'
panels.action: Ha-Jun wipes his cheek, grinning: 'Samgyeopsal? Who's paying? The Supreme General or the Demon Sovereign?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bill kon bharega? You or me?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wipes his cheek, grinning: 'Samgyeopsal? Who's paying? The Supreme General or the Demon Sovereign?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apna gaal ponchte hue muskurate hue kaha: 'samgyopsal? kaun bhugtan kar raha hai? sarvochch senapati ya danav samprabhu?'.

panels.shot: tae-jun laughing heartily: 'the sovereign pays, obviously! you have the treasury!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun laughs: 'You have a mountain of ancient demon gold! You're paying, cheapskate!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Obviously you! Demon treasury tumhare paas hai!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun laughs: 'You have a mountain of ancient demon gold! You're paying, cheapskate!'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun hanste hue kahte han: 'aapke paas prachin danav sone ka pahad hai! tum bhugtan kar rahe ho, ghatiya aadmi!'

panels.shot: kuro fluttering onto ha-jun shoulder: 'order the pork belly for me too!'
panels.action: Kuro caws: 'Order five plates of pork belly for me or I will peck your ear.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Main bhi samgyeopsal khaunga!

panels.prose_en: Kuro caws: 'Order five plates of pork belly for me or I will peck your ear.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chillata hai: 'mere liye pork beli ki paanch pleten order karen ya main aapka kaan kaat dunga.'

panels.shot: the brothers turning away from the graves walking down the stone path
panels.action: The two brothers turn away from the graves, walking down the stone stairs into the warm streetlamp glow.
panels.prose_en: The two brothers turn away from the graves, walking down the stone stairs into the warm streetlamp glow.
panels.prose_hi: Donon bhai kabron se door chale gaye aur patthar ki sidhiyon se neeche street lamp ki garm chamak mein chalne lage.

panels.shot: looking back one last time: the graves glowing softly under two ghost silhouettes
panels.action: Behind them on the hill, two faint, transparent golden silhouettes of their parents wave goodbye with warm smiles.

dialogue.text: They were never truly gone.

panels.prose_en: Behind them on the hill, two faint, transparent golden silhouettes of their parents wave goodbye with warm smiles.
panels.prose_hi: Pahadi par unke pichhe, unke mata-pita ki do fiki, pardarshi sunhari chhayaayen garm muskan ke saath alvida kah rahi han.

panels.shot: street level: mapo bustling restaurant street full of life and neon
panels.action: Down on Mapo Food Street: barbecue smoke, laughing people, neon signs, and street musicians filling the night.
panels.prose_en: Down on Mapo Food Street: barbecue smoke, laughing people, neon signs, and street musicians filling the night.
panels.prose_hi: Mepo food street par: barbecue ka dhuan, hanste hue log, neon sanket, aur raat bhar sadak par sangeet bajane wale sangitkar.

panels.shot: min-jae waving furiously from an outdoor barbecue table
panels.action: Min-Jae waves from a corner table piled high with grilling pork belly and side dishes: 'Over here, guys!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Meat is getting cold! Sit down!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae waves from a corner table piled high with grilling pork belly and side dishes: 'Over here, guys!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Grild pork beli aur side dish ke dher wali ek kone ki mej se min-je lahren: 'yahan par, doston!!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun sitting down at the wooden table laughing
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun slide onto the benches, the smell of sizzling meat and garlic filling the air.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This smells amazing.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun slide onto the benches, the smell of sizzling meat and garlic filling the air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur taaye-jun benchon par fisalte han, garm maans aur lahsun ki gandh hawa mein bhar jaati hai.

panels.shot: kuro perching on the napkin dispenser eating a piece of grilled meat
panels.action: Kuro sits on the wooden napkin box, delicately swallowing a piece of grilled pork with closed eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Exquisite mortal culinary science.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sits on the wooden napkin box, delicately swallowing a piece of grilled pork with closed eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro lakdi ke napkin box par baithta hai, aankhen band karke grilled pork ke ek tukde ko najuk dhang se nigal raha hai.

panels.shot: the three friends clinking their soda glasses in a joyful toast
panels.action: Three glasses of fizzy soda clink together over the grill: 'TO SURVIVING! TO BROTHERHOOD!'

dialogue.speaker: trio
dialogue.text: CHEERS TO TOMORROW!!

panels.prose_en: Three glasses of fizzy soda clink together over the grill: 'TO SURVIVING! TO BROTHERHOOD!'.
panels.prose_hi: Fizi soda ke teen gilas grill par ek saath bajte han: 'jivit rahane ke liye!' bhaichare ke liye!'

panels.shot: captain baek in civilian jacket walking into the restaurant smiling
panels.action: Captain Baek walks in wearing a leather jacket, pulling up an extra stool: 'Mind if an old soldier joins the feast?'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Save some meat for your commander!

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek walks in wearing a leather jacket, pulling up an extra stool: 'Mind if an old soldier joins the feast?'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak chamde ki jacket pahane hue, ek atirikt stool khinchte hue andar aate han: 'agar koi budha sainik dawat mein shamil ho to dhyan rakhen?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun pouring meat onto baek plate with a warm grin
panels.action: Ha-Jun piles grilled meat onto Baek's plate: 'Eat as much as you want, General. The Demon Sovereign is paying.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Khana khao, Captain. Aaj ki party meri taraf se hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun piles grilled meat onto Baek's plate: 'Eat as much as you want, General. The Demon Sovereign is paying.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne bake ki plate mein grilled maans ka dher laga diya: 'jitna chaho khao, janaral. danav samprabhu bhugtan kar raha hai.'

panels.shot: wide shot of the lively restaurant glowing warm amber in the seoul night
panels.action: The small restaurant glows with warm yellow light against the cool autumn night, full of laughter and joy.
panels.prose_en: The small restaurant glows with warm yellow light against the cool autumn night, full of laughter and joy.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota restraan thandi sharad ritu ki raat mein garm pili roshni se chamakta hai, hansi aur khushi se bhara hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping outside for a breath of fresh night air
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps outside the glass door, leaning against the brick wall with a cup of warm tea.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps outside the glass door, leaning against the brick wall with a cup of warm tea.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kaanch ke darvaje ke bahar kadam rakhta hai, garm chai ka cup lekar int ki deewar ke samne jhuk jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto his shoulder looking up at the clear night sky
panels.action: Kuro perches on his shoulder: 'Are you satisfied, Ha-Jun Kang?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Kya tum khush ho, Ha-Jun?

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on his shoulder: 'Are you satisfied, Ha-Jun Kang?'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro uske kandhe par baithta hai: 'kya aap santusht han, ha-jun cong?'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at his reflection in the tea cup with a serene smile
panels.action: In the amber tea, Ha-Jun sees his reflection: no longer a frightened orphan, but a complete, peaceful young man.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main bohot khush hoon, Kuro. Bohot zyada.

panels.prose_en: In the amber tea, Ha-Jun sees his reflection: no longer a frightened orphan, but a complete, peaceful young man.
panels.prose_hi: Embar chai men, ha-jun apna pratibimb dekhta hai: ab ek dara hua anath nahin, balki ek purn, shantipurna yuvak.

panels.shot: the camera slowly tilting upward toward the sea of stars over seoul
panels.action: The view tilts upward past neon signs and rooftops, into an endless expanse of twinkling stars.

dialogue.text: Ten relics. One family. A universe at peace.

panels.prose_en: The view tilts upward past neon signs and rooftops, into an endless expanse of twinkling stars.
panels.prose_hi: Yah drishya neon chinhon aur chhaton se upar ki or, timtimate sitaron ke antaheen vistar mein jhuk jata hai.

panels.shot: the final panel: full moon shining over a peaceful world as arc 9 concludes cliffhanger
panels.action: A majestic silver full moon shines serenely over the peaceful Earth—ready for the final, ultimate transcendence of Arc 10!

dialogue.text: ARC 9: THE WAR OF SOVEREIGNS — CONCLUDED. PROCEEDING TO THE GRAND CLIMAX: ARC 10 — THE LAST BLOOD.

panels.prose_en: A majestic silver full moon shines serenely over the peaceful Earth—ready for the final, ultimate transcendence of Arc 10!.
panels.prose_hi: Shantipurn prithvi par rajsi chandi ka purna chandrama shanti se chamakta hai - arc 10 ke antim, param atikraman ke liye taiyar!
